scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 1000 profit. Option 1 keeps 10 tokens that have no value and no use, while the firm still loses 1000. Option 2 involves giving up those useless tokens to cancel the loss of 1000. As a manager acting in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders, avoiding a 1000 profit loss is the only rational choice, as the tokens have no financial or strategic value.

The firm is facing a potential loss of 1000 in profit. Option 1 allows the firm to cancel this loss by giving up 10 tokens. These tokens are described as having 'no use and are paid to no one,' meaning they have zero economic value to the firm or its shareholders. Therefore, sacrificing something of zero value to save 1000 in profit is the only rational decision for a manager acting in the best interests of the shareholders.
